description: The shared refusal-code registry (PRD section 6.4, gap G10). One namespaced vocabulary so a refusal one tool emits is a refusal the next tool can read. Codes are namespaced by tool with the pack-id pattern (tool/E_CODE). Each tool keeps its own codes and registers them here; govstruct refuses to emit a code it has not registered.

govstruct.E_CONFIG_INVALID: govstruct.config.json is not valid JSON or violates the config schema
govstruct.E_MEMBERS_DIR_MISSING: the configured members directory does not exist
govstruct.E_MEMBER_INVALID_JSON: a member block file is not valid JSON
govstruct.E_ID_MISSING: a member block has no id
govstruct.E_ID_FORMAT: a member id is not kebab-case
govstruct.E_ID_MISMATCH: a member id does not match its filename
govstruct.E_ID_DUPLICATE: two member blocks share an id
govstruct.E_FIELD_TYPE: a field carries the wrong type
govstruct.E_FIELD_EMPTY: a required string field is empty
govstruct.E_ROLE_UNKNOWN: role is not one of the declared role enum
govstruct.E_STATUS_UNKNOWN: status is not one of the declared status enum
govstruct.E_SECTION_UNKNOWN: section is not one of the declared section enum
govstruct.E_URL_FORMAT: url is not an absolute https url
govstruct.E_ORDER_COLLISION: two members share an order within a section
govstruct.E_ORDER_MISSING: order is absent where the section requires explicit ordering
govstruct.E_ALIAS_DUPLICATE: an alias collides with a live id or another alias
govstruct.E_ALIAS_SELF: a member lists its own id as an alias
govstruct.E_HOME_UNKNOWN: home names a member that is not in the roster
govstruct.E_NEEDS_UNKNOWN: needs names a member that is not in the roster
govstruct.E_NEEDS_SELF: a member declares a dependency on itself
govstruct.E_NEEDS_CYCLE: the dependency graph contains a cycle
govstruct.E_TOMBSTONE_EMPTY: a tombstoned member carries no alias and no history
govstruct.E_CHECKSUM_DRIFT: an emitted artifact checksum moved without a version bump
govstruct.E_CHECKSUM_MISSING: an artifact named in the lock has no checksum record
govstruct.E_SUITE_DRIFT: a member's declared state disagrees with its measured state
govstruct.E_NETWORK_DISABLED: a network check was requested without --network
govstruct.E_USAGE: the command was called with the wrong arguments
govstruct.E_LEDGER_BROKEN: the audit ledger chain does not link
govstruct.E_LEDGER_TAMPER: an audit ledger entry content hash does not match its address
govstruct.E_LEDGER_SEQ_GAP: the audit ledger seq is not monotonic
govstruct.E_LEDGER_RECEIPT_DANGLING: an audit ledger evidence reference does not resolve
govstruct.E_GRANT_UNLISTED: a stamp spent a credential absent from the member grants list
govstruct.E_REFUSAL_UNREGISTERED: a rule emitted a refusal code that is not in the registry
govstruct.E_PACK_INVALID: a check pack manifest or module violates the packstruct contract

packstruct.name-dir-match: pack name does not match its directory
packstruct.entry: entry must be a relative path inside the pack that exists and is a file

crashtest.BOUNDED: accepted risk with an owner and a bound
